relationship_description: Aureo Nisce (Governor, La Union) is a cousin of Manuel Ortega, progenitor of the Ortega dynasty in La Union
Abdullah Dimaporo (House Member, Lanao del Norte) is the father of Mohamad Khalid Dimaporo, former governor and current representative of Lanao del Norte
Abdullah Dimaporo is married to Imelda Dimaporo, former governor and representative of Lanao del Norte
